LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_AnalystBonus: Research on any project goes 10% faster. Experience comes from operating scanners.
LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_GeneticistBonus: Research on gene and xenogerm projects goes 15% faster. Experience comes from making xenogerms.
LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_DarkScholarBonus: Dark Study (needs Anomaly): Anomaly research goes 15% faster and study efficiency rises 20%.
LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_AuthorBonus: Books you write gain one quality band, up to Excellent.
LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_MechCommanderBonus: Needs Biotech. A mechanitor with this role has 1 more mech bandwidth. Experience comes from work on mechanoids.
LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_DiplomatBonus: Negotiation ability rises 10% and social impact 5%. Experience comes from talking with guests, visitors and prisoners.
LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_ChemistBonus: A 10% chance of one extra unit when a drug or medicine bill finishes. Experience comes from making drugs and medicine.
LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_RoomsFound: Recognised: {0} Library, {1} Research Lab, {2} Gene Lab.
LanguageData.WFL_Intelligence_RoomsHelp: Rooms are recognised from what is in them, never painted. An enclosed room with gene equipment is a Gene Lab; with a research bench, a Research Lab; with at least two bookshelves and a table, a Library. Work done in a room that suits it earns 25% more experience: research at a bench in a Research Lab, a book in a Library, a xenogerm in a Gene Lab.

LanguageData.WFL_Sciences_LeadHelp: The lead researcher is a record of your choice, shown here and in the list below. It does not change research speed or anything else in the game.
